Latin word

amplius

adverb, comparative; as a noun, “more” · Wiktionary

more, further, any longer; more, further, any more: something added to what there already is

In this lexicon

  • further

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. S. 1.1.121: verbum nōn amplius addam; Hor. S. 2.6.4: nīl amplius ōrō

  • more

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. S. 2.6.4: nīl amplius ōrō; Traupman 347

  • Patī nequeō amplius.: I can’t take any more

    classical

    that’s enough now. I won’t add a word furtherHor. S. 1.1.120–121
